$comment: cu2: Line's ONE set of per-step AI profiles (contract: StepProfile in packages/engine/line/contract.mjs). Cockpit's LLM capabilities (ui/server settings llmProviders), Trace's AI tasks (trace/ai.config.json now holds only overrides) and the @mx/reason pairs all read their model, reply cap and ladder from here. Static always runs first; a model rung is on only where measured to help; every step falls back to static. Local models only: nothing here pulls or stops a model.

profiles.label: Suggests the next step a developer most likely wants from the steps on offer.
profiles.guidance: Pick the next step a developer most likely wants from the offered steps.
profiles.question: Which step does the developer most likely want next?

profiles.label: After Construct refuses a change, picks which of its typed fixes to try next.
profiles.guidance: Construct refused the change; pick the typed fix that resolves the refusal. The first fix is Construct's recommended one.
profiles.question: Which fix resolves the refusal?

ladder.measured: 2026-10-11 qwen2.5-coder:1.5b: no feedback 6/10, refusal sentence 8/10, sentence and typed fixes 9/10

profiles.label: When Construct refuses an option Qwen or jev chose, makes one repair from the exact error and its typed fixes; if Construct still refuses it, you decide.
profiles.guidance: Construct refused this change. Change only what the error and its typed fixes say, and answer with the corrected change in the same shape.

ladder.measured: 2026-10-12 qwen2.5-coder:1.5b: one repair landed 7 of 20 seeded Train Line refusals (35%); 11 gave back the same change, 2 were refused again

profiles.label: Picks where one part of a page gets its data from, citing a fact that settles it.
profiles.guidance: Pick the option the cited facts support; never static text.
profiles.question: Which option do the facts support?

profiles.label: Picks the API fields that feed one part of a page.
profiles.guidance: Pick every field the cited facts support.
profiles.question: Which fields feed this part?

profiles.label: Writes one expression for a placeholder, kept only when it reproduces the design's examples.
Puts an open item in plain words for the run summary, checked against its facts.
Rewrites a team email on request; every draft is fact-checked and never sent by itself.
Answers questions about one part in the Part inspector, fact-checked and never applied by itself.
Proposes one sample value for a contract field that has no example.
Proposes a page story with a goal and acceptance points, never saved by itself.
Fills one imported file's gaps, shown as a diff you approve.
Fills a newly created unit's body, shown as a diff you approve.
Analyses a whole feature for import with a hosted model you choose; it never runs on a local model.
